Dry run first. It adds IELTS Playbook Premium and SAT Playbook Premium (59,000 UZS / 30 days and 149,000 UZS / 90 days each), SAT Exam Simulator Standard (69,000 UZS / 30 days; the simulator was paywalled with no active plan), and the IELTS Complete (179,000) and SAT Complete (159,000) products with 30-day plans. Edge, after the migration (--project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel): supabase functions deploy access-effective; supabase functions deploy me; supabase functions deploy start-session; supabase functions deploy exam-state; supabase functions deploy review-session; supabase functions deploy trial-claim; supabase functions deploy learning-profile; supabase functions deploy score-prediction; supabase functions deploy recommendations.
